title: PersonaFuse: A Situation-Aware Post-Training Framework for Adaptive LLM Behavior in Enterprise Tasks
abstract: arXiv:2509.07370v4 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed in enterprise settings to support task execution and workflow automation. Despite the strong performance of general-purpose models on standard benchmarks, organizations often need to adapt them to domain-specific tasks and operational constraints in practice. However, existing post-training approaches introduce capability trade-offs and lack mechanisms for situational adaptation. In this work, we propose PersonaFuse, a post-training framework that enables situation-aware behavioral adaptation in LLMs. Grounded in Trait Activation Theory and operationalized through the Five-Factor Model, PersonaFuse dynamically adjusts model behavior based on task context using a mixture-of-experts architecture with trait-level experts and a context-aware routing mechanism. We evaluate PersonaFuse at three levels. At the capability level, it achieves balanced improvements across general reasoning,

translated_title: PersonaFuse：面向企业任务中自适应大语言模型行为的情境感知后训练框架
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）正越来越多地被部署于企业环境中，以支持任务执行和工作流自动化。尽管通用模型在标准基准测试中表现优异，但在实践中，组织往往需要将其适配到特定领域的任务和运营约束中。然而，现有的后训练方法会引入能力上的权衡，且缺乏情境适应机制。在本工作中，我们提出了PersonaFuse，一个能够实现情境感知行为适配的大语言模型后训练框架。PersonaFuse以特质激活理论为基础，并通过大五人格模型加以实现，利用带有特质级专家和上下文感知路由机制的混合专家架构，根据任务情境动态调整模型行为。我们在三个层面对PersonaFuse进行评估。在能力层面，它在通用推理、（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: PersonaFuse是一个基于特质激活理论与大五人格模型的后训练框架，通过带有特质级专家和上下文感知路由的混合专家架构，使大语言模型能够根据企业任务情境动态调整自身行为，实现无能力权衡的情境自适应表现。
en_tdlr: PersonaFuse is a post-training framework grounded in Trait Activation Theory and the Five-Factor Model, which employs a mixture-of-experts architecture with trait-level experts and context-aware routing to enable situation-aware, adaptive LLM behavior in enterprise tasks without capability trade-offs.
